title: Sahassa
text: 1. Ekaṃ samayam āyasmā Anuruddho Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme || || 2--3. Atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yenāyasmā Anuruddho tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā Anuruddhena saddhiṃ || la-pe || āyasmantam || Anuruddham etad avocuṃ || || Katamesam āyasmā Anuruddho dhammānam bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā mahābhiññatam patto ti || Catunnaṃ khvāham āvuso || pe || mahābhiññatam patto || katamesaṃ catunnaṃ || || 4. Idhāham āvuso kāye kāyanupassī viharāmi || vedanāsu || citte || dhammesu dhammānupassī viharāmi ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyyaloke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || || Imesaṃ khvāham āvuso catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānam bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā mahābhiññatam patto || || 5. Imesañ ca panāham āvuso catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānam bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā kappasahassam anussarāmī ti || ||
